verdict.rationale: Snowflake's own Time Travel feature keeps changed or deleted data for a defined period and lets users restore deleted tables or whole containers, which addresses part of data retention and deletion. The evidence never shows that users can set the retention period, permanently purge data, or apply retention policies. Missing for 10: documented user-configurable retention periods, controls for permanent deletion or purge, retention policies applied to AI/Cortex data, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Snowflake Time Travel enables accessing historical data (that is, data that has been changed or deleted) at any point within a defined period.
Restoring objects that might have been accidentally or intentionally deleted. You can restore individual objects, such as tables, or restore all the objects inside a container object
